rdfs:label: altitude
rdfs:comment: The altitude of an ActivityStreams Place above sea level, expressed in metres unless `as:units` says otherwise.
notes: Default unit is metres; override with `as:units` (`cm`, `feet`, `inches`, `km`, `m`, `miles`, or a unit URI) when the source data carries something else. Negative values are valid (Death Valley, the Dead Sea); zero is sea level by definition. Upstream domain is `as:Place`; `urn:solid:Place` maps to schema:Place, so when producing AS2 data type the node `as:Place` (as the example does) and use the AS latitude/longitude IRIs (`urn:solid:latitude`/`longitude` map to schema.org).
